title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff & regional failover thresholds to prevent thrashing
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: After a production incident on 2026-02-18 we observed SLO enforcer oscillation in regions with transient capacity pressure. The enforcer backoff and circuit breaker ordering allowed rapid regional failover followed by aggressive re-attach which caused repeated load-shedding and visible latency spikes for tenant-facing endpoints. This hotfix tightens the backoff ordering, smooths threshold transitions, and adds an additional safety-window to regional failover logic. Changes include: 1) adjust backoff multiplier cap and introduce jitter floor to reduce synchronized retries; 2) add ordering guarantees so regional CB backoff state is persisted and evaluated before enabling failover; 3) smooth threshold transitions with a short hysteresis window to prevent thrash when a region flaps; 4) metric labels to allow per-tenant and per-region SLO debugging; 5) add integration test that simulates transient regional overload and asserts no more than one failover per 30s for a given tenant. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy enforcer service canary in us-west-2 with 10% of traffic for 2 hours, observe SLO error-rate and failover_count metrics, then increase to 50% and finally full rollout. Rollback: revert the connected feature flag (feature.slo_enforcer.backoff_v2) or rollback canary by traffic-split. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration test added, [x] e2e smoke locally, [x] metrics dashboard updated, [x] feature flag gating. Impact: low risk to config semantics - default behavior unchanged unless feature flag enabled. This is targeted as a hotfix because the current behavior caused customer-visible thrashing under load.

review_comments: Miguel Santos (2026-02-21): Can you clarify why the cap was reduced from 8 to 4? I'm worried we might underreact to prolonged pressure. RESPONSE: Aisha Kapoor: empirical testing on our canary trace showed 8x allowed synchronized retry waves; 4x with jitter floor eliminated waves in 95th-percentile scenarios while still allowing recovery on sustained pressure.

Claire Huang (2026-02-22): Nit: add a log line when hysteresis window blocks a failover for observability. RESPONSE: Aisha Kapoor: added a 'hysteresis_block' instrumented log and metric in region_state.go (see file diff).

Benji Patel (2026-02-23): test flakiness? The new integration test failed once in CI run 2. RESPONSE: Aisha Kapoor: adjusted test timing to use deterministic scheduler and extended wait assertions; reran CI, test is stable locally and in CI run 4.
release_notes: Hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff ordering and threshold smoothing to reduce regional failover thrashing. Includes metric and dashboard updates. Rollout gated behind feature.slo_enforcer.backoff_v2.
notes: Incident: customer-visible thrashing on 2026-02-18 triggered SRE playbook and temporary mitigation (feature flag revert) before this fix
Monitoring: observe metrics slo_enforcer.failover_count, slo_enforcer.backoff_applied, and region.request_error_rate during canary
Follow-up: consider making hysteresis window configurable per-tenant for very bursty workloads (ENG-3124)
